text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер's chance at victory in the
Japan
Cup escapes her. But she wastes
no time sulking,
and strengthens her
resolve for what will come.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now more determined than ever, she
zeroes in on
the upcoming showdown
with Марузенски at the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Эль Кондор Паса leaves the
venue in a
hurry, almost as if running
away from Grass
Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Emotions whirl as the winds grow colder.
Winter is
on the horizon, but Grass
Wonder's classic year is
far from over
yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
